entry.name: jit.vcr
entry.digest: Record a movie with MSP audio
entry.description: Use the jit.vcr object combine a sequence of Jitter matrices and MSP audio and save the sequence to disk as a synchronized movie. The two left inlets accept MSP audio signals (if only 1 inlet is used, the movie's audio will be monophonic). The right inlet accepts a Jitter matrix.
